title: Effect of maxillary sinus floor elevation on nasal mucociliary clearance: a prospective saccharin transit time study
html: Maxillary sinus floor elevation (MSFE) is widely performed to facilitate implant placement in the atrophic posterior maxilla. However, its functional impact on nasal mucociliary clearance (MCC) remains insufficiently clarified. This prospective study aimed to investigate temporal changes in nasal MCC following MSFE using the saccharin transit time (STT) test. Thirty-three non-smoking American Society of Anesthesiologists class I patients (20 females, 13 males; mean ± SD age 49.1 ± 10.7 years) undergoing MSFE were included.
